main_text.p: סָעַר Fulcivit, Suffulcivit, Suftentavit. Chald. סְעַר Suffulcire, Juvare, Ad- juvare. Partic. Pahel plur. מְסַעֲדִין Adju- vantes, Esr.5 2.
סָעִיף סַעַף m. Ramus: Scopulus: Cogitatio: plur. סְעָפִים, & cum Sin, שְׂעָפִים.
שַׂעַר סַעַר m. Turbo, Tempestas, Procella: Fœm. שְׂעָרָה סְעָרָה plur. סְעָרוֹת.

סָעַר Procellosum esse vel fieri, Procellis agita- ri: Proturbare, Procellere, Niphal cum Sin, נִשְׂעַר Procellosum esse. Pihel שִׂעֵר. Procellere, Procellâ aut Turbine abripere. Pyhal Futurum יִסְעַר Turbine abripitur, Hos.13.3: cum Tzere loco Pathach.
סָפַר Plangere, Planctum agere, Lugere. Niphal נִסְפַּד Plangi.
סָפָה Confumi, Perdi, Deficere, quomodo cum סוּף convenit, & activè, Confumere, Perdere:

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are approximated where the scan is blurred; the Hebrew words in the first lines and some of the Hebrew forms with points may contain small errors. Latin long s rendered as plain s. The watermark "Digitized by Google" at the lower right is omitted.
